annotation.speech2: Five nested ellipses centred at the origin, all twice as tall as they are wide, with a legend in the upper left. They are shaded from dark green for the innermost, where c equals nought point two, out to yellow for the outermost, where c equals one, in equal steps of nought point two.
The innermost level curve, where g equals nought point two.
The outermost level curve, where g equals one. It is the ellipse x squared plus y squared over four equals one, crossing the x axis at plus and minus one and the y axis at plus and minus two.
The ellipses are stretched along the y axis because the y term is divided by four, so reaching a given height takes twice the distance in y that it does in x.
